title: bug: Memory.add() missing `llm` parameter present in AsyncMemory.add()
author: ShauryaaSharma

comments.author: ShauryaaSharma
comments.body:
`AsyncMemory.add()` has accepted an `llm` parameter since #5710 allowing callers to pass a custom LangChain model for procedural memory, but `Memory.add()` was never updated to match, so sync users got a `TypeError` trying to use the same API.

This PR adds `llm=None` to both `Memory.add()` and sync `_create_procedural_memory()`, implementing the same `llm.invoke()` LangChain path as the async version. No behaviour change when `llm` is not passed.

Solved the issue here: #5912
